answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the hollow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The jade holds work receipts rather than names, so the inlet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
